facts: The Portfolio (/portfolio) is a saved list of programs you are tracking or have acquired — stored locally in localStorage.
The Stack Simulator (/simulator) lets you pick programs and see combined metrics: total cost, avg sovereignty, longest timeline, and stacking synergy.
Value Forks show pathway-level capital analysis — minimum investment vs typical, with proof status and stacking synergy per pathway.
Compare (/compare) is a side-by-side matrix of 2-4 programs across finance, timeline, scores, and stacking metrics.
Stacking synergy (high/medium/low) indicates how well programs complement each other for Bitcoin-first users.
Sovereignty score (0-10) rates a jurisdiction's independence — higher means more control over your assets and residency.
BTC Dual Price shows USD amounts alongside their Bitcoin equivalent at current market rates.
Saved Stacks are named combinations of programs stored locally (max 20) — restore them with one click.
Portfolio order matters — drag to reorder, and the stack simulator respects your priority sequence.
The portfolio can be shared via URL — anyone with the link sees the same program combination.
Compliance Clock shows the timeline for flagship programs — key milestones and deadlines.
The simulator summary copies a text summary of your stack: programs, cost, sovereignty, timeline.
Value Forks calculate potential savings by choosing minimum-pathway investments over typical costs.
Compare highlights the best value in each metric column — green badge marks the winner.
Portfolio stats show: program count, total investment (USD + BTC), avg crypto-friendly score, Lightning-ready count.
Programs with flagship depth have detailed pathway analysis in the Value Forks panel.
The simulator links to Compare when 2-4 programs are selected for deeper side-by-side analysis.
Portfolio data is device-local — it does not sync across devices without the share URL.
Stacking synergy is derived from each program's stacking_synergy field in countries.json.

pages./portfolio: Saved program list with stats, Compliance Clock, portfolio cards, Paige chat, and links to simulator/compare
pages./simulator: Pick programs, see combined metrics (cost, sovereignty, timeline, synergy), save named stacks, Value Forks
pages./compare: Side-by-side matrix of 2-4 programs across finance, timeline, scores, stacking metrics
pages./programs: Browse all 50 programs, add to portfolio, filter and sort

metrics.total_cost: Sum of typical investment USD across selected programs
metrics.avg_sovereignty: Average sovereignty score (0-10) across selected programs
metrics.longest_timeline: Maximum processing time in months across selected programs
metrics.stacking_synergy: Count of high/medium/low synergy programs in the stack
metrics.fork_savings: Difference between typical total cost and minimum-pathway total cost
metrics.crypto_friendly_score: 0-10 rating of crypto/friendly environment per program

honesty_rules: Portfolio and stacks are device-local — they do not sync across devices.
Costs shown are typical estimates from countries.json — actual costs vary by pathway and advisor.
Sovereignty scores are modeled estimates — verify with local legal counsel.
Stacking synergy is a heuristic indicator — it does not guarantee operational compatibility.
BTC price conversion is approximate and changes with market rates.
Saved stacks are limited to 20 — older stacks are removed when the limit is hit.

member_scripts.what_is_portfolio: Your portfolio is a saved list of programs you are tracking. It shows combined stats like total investment, average sovereignty score, and how many are Lightning-ready. You can reorder programs by priority.
member_scripts.what_is_simulator: The Stack Simulator lets you pick any combination of programs and see the combined metrics — total cost, average sovereignty, longest timeline, and how well they stack together for Bitcoin-first users.
member_scripts.what_are_value_forks: Value Forks show the cheapest pathway for each program in your stack — the minimum investment you could start with, compared to the typical cost. It also shows proof status and stacking synergy.
member_scripts.how_to_compare: Select 2-4 programs in the simulator and click Compare to see a side-by-side matrix. It highlights the best value in each category — cost, timeline, sovereignty, and crypto-friendliness.
member_scripts.what_is_stacking_synergy: Stacking synergy (high/medium/low) indicates how well a program complements others for Bitcoin-first users. High synergy means the program works well alongside other jurisdictions.
member_scripts.what_is_sovereignty: Sovereignty score (0-10) rates how independent a jurisdiction is — higher means more control over your assets, residency, and financial freedom.
member_scripts.how_to_save_stack: In the simulator, name your stack and click Save. You can save up to 20 named combinations and restore them with one click. Share via URL to show others.
member_scripts.how_to_share: Copy the share URL from the Portfolio or Simulator — anyone with the link sees the same program combination. The URL encodes the program IDs.
member_scripts.what_is_btc_price: BTC Dual Price shows USD amounts alongside their Bitcoin equivalent at current market rates — so you can think in sats when evaluating investments.
member_scripts.what_is_compliance_clock: Compliance Clock shows the timeline for flagship programs — key milestones like application submission, processing, approval, and residency activation.
